data.title: TDS Shared Infrastructure Correlation
data.description: Detects domains from different apparent campaigns sharing hosting infrastructure, nameservers, or registration patterns — indicating a common TDS operator serving multiple affiliates. This rule performs graph-based correlation by identifying domains resolving to the same IP CIDR block with different registrant information but similar registration timing. TDS operators frequently reuse backend infrastructure across campaigns while rotating customer-facing domains, creating detectable infrastructure overlap patterns. Shared nameserver configurations, co-located IP assignments within the same /24 CIDR, and registration timestamps clustered within hours are strong indicators of centralized TDS management across ostensibly independent fraud campaigns.

enrichment_required.source: Temporal analytics enrichment (registration timing delta calculation)

falsepositives: Shared hosting providers where unrelated customers legitimately occupy the same CIDR block
CDN or cloud provider IP ranges that host many unrelated domains
Domain parking services that cluster domains on shared infrastructure
